Current pending kind5 successors correct an inherited residual reference loader defect: m007_fullmodel_encoder_1d_tb172d3019 and binary-kind5 successor246c2d6a load the entire original131072x32bit GOLD.hex into a scalar temporary, then zero-delay pack residual_a[g][32*l+:32]=scalar[32*g+l] for all4096x32 lanes. Top names, original files, clocks/delays, W peers and numerical assertions are preserved. Old5f759f/719e/frozen37e8/R006 and original failures remain historical. New fullgraph677e5bc9 does not use this scalar fixture and remains unchanged. [Repair, exact source manifests and minimal diffs](../experiment_results/runs/R007/residual_loader_repair_delivery.json).

AT047/048 add bounded read-only compatibility review only. Current fullgraph677e5bc9 has15 exact-width/capacity one-dimensional readmemh calls; inspected Verilator5.020 runtime supports the peer unsigned byte FREAD mapping and binary output NUL/high-bit bytes. Exactly3 SIDEEFFECT diagnostics on one softmax increment and2 MODDUP legacy definitions were examined against the actual AT013 source manifest and generated C++. Pure automatic tr/tv functions and3 actual generated blocks each preserve all8 sequential group increments. The two tile_bank module bodies are byte-identical; tile_service_v1 bodies differ (prefetch staging) but neither legacy module has a current-top instance. No production/TB edit or EDA was performed.
